subject: [hw] T01 -> lead: V14 appears idle and has one open 3-line T16 bug (LSRS/ASRS reg by 0); blocks thumb-O0 zero
body: R1 independently confirmed F4 and I gave V14 the exact root cause: emu/n2a32_t16.c t16_shift() has `if (n == 0) n = 32;` for LSR/ASR, which is correct for the immediate encodings but wrong for the register forms (case 0x3/0x4). A register shift by 0 must leave the value and C unchanged. Suggested fix: pass an `immediate` flag so the n==0->32 conversion only applies to the immediate path; register n==0 falls through to the existing no-shift branch. Current corpus: thumb-O0 35 mismatches = k_crc32 15 + k_v15_rev 20, all this bug; thumb-O2/O3v are already 0 mismatches. V14s worker runtime was last written 11:28 and their STATUS is rev 1; if they are not coming back, this tiny edit needs an owner. Everything else on the A32/T32-DP side is green; remaining stops are only the not-yet-landed V16/V17/V18-V20 files.
